parsed.summary: The proposed patch changes the behavior of `Contains.as_set` to return the set it contains, which may resolve the immediate issue but could introduce unexpected behavior.

issues.description: The change may break existing code that relies on `Contains.as_set` raising a `NotImplementedError`. It is unclear how this will affect other parts of the codebase that interact with `Contains` objects.
The change could be made more readable by adding a comment explaining why `self.args[1]` is returned.
